narr: A large cluster of severe thunderstorms moved southeastward out of Kentucky across northeastern Middle Tennessee during the early morning hours of July 21. Numerous reports of wind damage were received.
ev: A car was stranded in flood waters on Willow Avenue between Spring Street and Broad Street.
lsr: A CAR GOT STRANDED ON WILLOW AVE. BETWEEN SPRING ST AND BROAD ST. DUE TO FLOODING.
